findings.text: follow-on: the 20-trial gate uses -p discard_repeat, a plugin absent from the repository, so the exact done-when measurement cannot be re-run from the committed tree, though the committed single test still discriminates at base per population-base.log.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit (931b4904 adds the race test, 7ffdab48 wraps the release unlink in _pointer_lock, f3ed6457 makes the test expose the late publish).
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks the test to pass 20 of 20 at -n 8 beside a CPU-bound load with a main negative control; head-20-contended.log records "20 passed" and base-20-contended.log "20 failed" beside 8 spinners.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a discarded run's pointer is not rewritten by its supervisor; the diff at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1918 serialises the release unlink under _pointer_lock so a late phase publish cannot restore it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names the recreating write at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5043 and records the base/head 20-trial results with their log paths.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/dispatch.py and tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py; the diff between base and head touches only those two files.

justifications.durability: the added assertion at tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py:1348 (not pointer.exists()) reddens when the release lock is removed, as base-20-contended.log shows at product base bbb3eb9b.
justifications.evidence: head-20-contended.log records 20 passed and base-20-contended.log 20 failed at the recreated-pointer assertion, but the gate command depends on an uncommitted -p discard_repeat plugin.
justifications.fit: the change reuses the existing _pointer_lock (reckon/crew/runs.py:512) and adds no function, class or module.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1918 takes _pointer_lock around the release unlink, the same lock _publish_stored_phase holds at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:10268.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff bbb3eb9b..f3ed6457 --name-only lists only reckon/crew/dispatch.py and tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py, both inside the declared write paths.
